To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
wheat chromosome translocation line TA5594 is highly tolerant to HT stress at the grain filling period, based on the heat response of Fv/Fm to individual grain weight.

wheat chromosome translocation (TA) lines were screened for heat stress tolerance at the reproductive stage and TA5594, 5617, and 5088 were highly heat tolerant and TA5635, TA5637, and TA5640 highly heat susceptible.
Wheat chromosome translocation line TA5617 was the most tolerant to high temperature stress during the grain-filling stage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a heat tolerant wheat cultivar through genetic manipulation.
identifying wheat genotypes that are tolerant to HT stress and with understanding the physiological basis of HT stress tolerance in wheat.
the evaluation of wheat translocation lines for tolerance to HT during the grain filling period.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is genetic variation in wheat for HT stress tolerance and that this variation is associated with change in Fv / Fm.
there is considerable genetic variation for heat susceptibility among wheat chromosome translocations and this can be used to improve heat tolerance.
there is genetic variation among wheat chromosome translocations for HT stress tolerance during the grain filling phase.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the translocation lines can be used to identify and isolate genes for high temperature tolerance in wheat.
we have developed a set of wheat chromosome translocations lines with potential for high temperature tolerance at grain filling stage.
the translocation lines are useful for the introgression of heat stress tolerance into bread wheat and for the study of the physiological and genetic bases of heat tolerance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
wheat translocation lines are a useful tool in wheat breeding to introgress HT stress tolerance genes into wheat cultivars.
wheat chromosome translocation is a useful tool for introgression of heat tolerance genes from wild relatives to wheat.
the wheat chromosome translocation line TA5594 has a high level of tolerance to high temperature stress during the grain-filling stage.
